                                  a_square::Float32, variance_I::Float32,
                                  variance_spatial::Float32, radius::Int32)
    idx0 = (blockIdx().x - Int32(1)) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x - Int32(1)
    idy0 = (blockIdx().y - Int32(1)) * blockDim().y + threadIdx().y - Int32(1)
    if idx0 >= w || idy0 >= h
        return
    end

    id = idy0 * w + idx0
    center = input[id + Int32(1)]

include(joinpath(@__DIR__,"study_fixture.jl"))
const STUDY_REPEATS=100
function studycase(run!,fields)
 offset=STUDY_ELEMENTS*512;input=STUDY_Q[1:fields*offset];output=Vector{Float32}(undef,fields*offset)
 CUDA.synchronize();t=time_ns();G=CuArray(STUDY_G);Q=CuArray(input);A=CuArray{Float32}(undef,length(output));D=CuArray(STUDY_D);L=CuArray(STUDY_LAMBDA)
 for repeat in 1:STUDY_REPEATS;run!(fields,Int32(offset),G,D,L,Q,A);end
 copyto!(output,A)
 for a in (G,Q,A,D,L);CUDA.unsafe_free!(a);end
 CUDA.synchronize();elapsed=(time_ns()-t)*1e-9/STUDY_REPEATS
 expected=STUDY_EXPECTED[1:fields*offset];maxerr=maximum(abs.(Float64.(output).-Float64.(expected)));ok=maxerr<1e-3
 return output,ok,maxerr,elapsed
end
function study(run!)
 CUDA.functional()||error("CUDAunavailable");get(ENV,"JULIA_CUDA_MEMORY_POOL","")=="none"||error("Poolmustbedisabledfortimedfree")
 for fields in (1,3);studycase(run!,fields);end
 for trial in 1:5
  got=Float32[];total=0.;ok=true;maxerr=0.
  for fields in (1,3);output,good,err,elapsed=studycase(run!,fields);append!(got,output);total+=elapsed;ok&=good;maxerr=max(maxerr,err);end
  path=joinpath(get(ENV,"STUDY_OUTPUT_DIR",pwd()),"trial_$(trial).bin");open(io->write(io,got),path,"w")
  println("STUDY_TRIAL {\"trial\":",trial,",\"time_seconds\":",total,",\"correct\":",ok,",\"checked_values\":14336,\"max_abs_error\":",maxerr,",\"timing_region\":\"sum_scalar_fused3_allocate_h2d_100kernels_d2h_free_perrepeat\",\"jit_excluded\":true,\"internal_repeats\":100,\"output_artifact\":{\"path\":\"",path,"\",\"dtype\":\"float32\",\"count\":14336,\"byte_order\":\"little\"}}")
  ok||error("Helmholtzfulloutputoraclefailed")
 end
end

module OwnedStudy
using CUDA, Printf
"""Five in-process synchronized host-clock trials, JIT warmed before trial 1.
The same timed launch loop and reset/output boundaries apply to all models.
Full-array CPU checks are outside timing; raw outputs enable dual comparisons.
"""
function run_trials!(launch!, reset!, readback, expected, repeats; atol=0.0, rtol=0.0)
    repeats > 0 || error("positive internal repeat count required")
    reset!(); launch!(); CUDA.synchronize()
    allok = true
    for trial in 1:5
        reset!(); CUDA.synchronize()
        start = time_ns()
        for _ in 1:repeats
            launch!()
        end
        CUDA.synchronize()
        secs = (time_ns()-start)*1e-9/repeats
        got = vec(readback()); ref = vec(expected)
        length(got)==length(ref) || error("output shape mismatch")
        maxabs=0.0; maxrel=0.0; ok=true
        for (x,y) in zip(got,ref)
            a=abs(Float64(x)-Float64(y))
            b=a/max(abs(Float64(y)),atol,1e-300)
            ok &= isfinite(x) && isfinite(y) && a<=atol+rtol*abs(y)
            maxabs=max(maxabs,a); maxrel=max(maxrel,b)
        end
        allok &= ok
        name="output_trial$(trial).bin"
        path=joinpath(get(ENV,"STUDY_OUTPUT_DIR",pwd()),name)
        write(path,got)
        dtype=eltype(got)==Float32 ? "float32" : eltype(got)==Float64 ? "float64" : eltype(got)==Int32 ? "int32" : eltype(got)==Int64 ? "int64" : error("unsupported dtype")
        @printf("STUDY_TRIAL {\"trial\":%d,\"time_seconds\":%.12g,\"correct\":%s,\"checked_values\":%d,\"max_abs_error\":%.12g,\"max_rel_error\":%.12g,\"timing_region\":\"kernel_launch_loop_per_internal_repeat\",\"jit_excluded\":true,\"internal_repeats\":%d,\"output_artifact\":{\"path\":\"%s\",\"dtype\":\"%s\",\"count\":%d,\"byte_order\":\"little\"}}\n",trial,secs,ok ? "true" : "false",length(got),maxabs,maxrel,repeats,path,dtype,length(got))
    end
    allok || error("CPU numerical verification failed")
    println("PASS")
end
end

using CUDA
using Printf

struct XYZ
    x::Float32
    y::Float32
    z::Float32
end

function parse_args(args)
    work_group_size = 256
    file_name = "../bezier-surface-cuda/input/control.txt"
    in_size = 3
    out_size = 300

    i = 1
    while i <= length(args)
        arg = args[i]
        if arg == "-h"
            println("Usage: main.jl [-g work_group_size] [-f input_file] [-m input_size] [-n output_size]")
            return nothing
        elseif arg == "-g" && i < length(args)
            i += 1
            work_group_size = parse(Int, args[i])
        elseif arg == "-f" && i < length(args)
            i += 1
            file_name = args[i]
        elseif arg == "-m" && i < length(args)
            i += 1
            in_size = parse(Int, args[i])
        elseif arg == "-n" && i < length(args)
            i += 1
            out_size = parse(Int, args[i])
        else
            error("Unrecognized option: $arg")
        end
        i += 1
    end

    return (; work_group_size, file_name, in_size_i=in_size, in_size_j=in_size,
            out_size_i=out_size, out_size_j=out_size)
end

function read_input(file_name::AbstractString, in_size_i::Int, in_size_j::Int)
    open(file_name, "r") do io
        println("Read data from file $file_name")
        points = XYZ[]
        for line in eachline(io)
            fields = split(strip(line), ',')
            length(fields) == 3 || continue
            push!(points, XYZ(parse(Float32, fields[1]),
                              parse(Float32, fields[2]),
                              parse(Float32, fields[3])))
        end

        isempty(points) && error("input file has no control points")
        out = Vector{XYZ}(undef, (in_size_i + 1) * (in_size_j + 1))
        k = 1
        for i in 0:in_size_i, j in 0:in_size_j
            out[i * (in_size_j + 1) + j + 1] = points[k]
            k = k == 16 ? 1 : k + 1
        end
        return out
    end
end

function bezier_blend(k::Int, mu::Float32, n::Int)
    nn = n
    kn = k
    nkn = n - k
    blend = Float32(1)
    while nn >= 1
        blend *= Float32(nn)
        nn -= 1
        if kn > 1
            blend /= Float32(kn)
            kn -= 1
        end
        if nkn > 1
            blend /= Float32(nkn)
            nkn -= 1
        end
    end
    if k > 0
        blend *= mu ^ Float32(k)
    end
    if n - k > 0
        blend *= (Float32(1) - mu) ^ Float32(n - k)
    end
    return blend
end

function bezier_cpu(inp::Vector{XYZ}, ni::Int, nj::Int, resolution_i::Int, resolution_j::Int)
    outp = Vector{XYZ}(undef, resolution_i * resolution_j)
    for i in 0:(resolution_i - 1)
        mui = Float32(i) / Float32(resolution_i - 1)
        for j in 0:(resolution_j - 1)
            muj = Float32(j) / Float32(resolution_j - 1)
            ox = Float32(0)
            oy = Float32(0)
            oz = Float32(0)
            for ki in 0:ni
                bi = bezier_blend(ki, mui, ni)
                for kj in 0:nj
                    bj = bezier_blend(kj, muj, nj)
                    p = inp[ki * (nj + 1) + kj + 1]
                    w = bi * bj
                    ox += p.x * w
                    oy += p.y * w
                    oz += p.z * w
                end
            end
            outp[i * resolution_j + j + 1] = XYZ(ox, oy, oz)
        end
    end
    return outp
end

function bezier_gpu_kernel(inp, outp, ni::Int32, nj::Int32, resolution_i::Int32, resolution_j::Int32)
    i = (blockIdx().x - Int32(1)) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x - Int32(1)
    if i >= resolution_i
        return
    end

    mui = Float32(i) / Float32(resolution_i - Int32(1))
    for j in Int32(0):(resolution_j - Int32(1))
        muj = Float32(j) / Float32(resolution_j - Int32(1))
        ox = Float32(0)
        oy = Float32(0)
        oz = Float32(0)
        for ki in Int32(0):ni
            bi = bezier_blend(Int(ki), mui, Int(ni))
            for kj in Int32(0):nj
                bj = bezier_blend(Int(kj), muj, Int(nj))
                p = @inbounds inp[ki * (nj + Int32(1)) + kj + Int32(1)]
                w = bi * bj
                ox += p.x * w
                oy += p.y * w
                oz += p.z * w
            end
        end
        @inbounds outp[i * resolution_j + j + Int32(1)] = XYZ(ox, oy, oz)
    end
    return
end

function compare_output(gpu_out::Vector{XYZ}, cpu_out::Vector{XYZ})
    sum_delta = 0.0
    sum_ref = 0.0
    @inbounds for idx in eachindex(cpu_out)
        g = gpu_out[idx]
        c = cpu_out[idx]
        sum_delta += abs(Float64(g.x - c.x)) + abs(Float64(g.y - c.y)) + abs(Float64(g.z - c.z))
        sum_ref += abs(Float64(c.x)) + abs(Float64(c.y)) + abs(Float64(c.z))
    end
    l1norm = sum_delta / sum_ref
    if l1norm >= 1e-6
        println("Test failed")
        return 1
    end
    return 0
end

function main(args)
    params = parse_args(args)
    params === nothing && return 0

    input = read_input(params.file_name, params.in_size_i, params.in_size_j)

    cpu_start = time_ns()
    cpu_out = bezier_cpu(input, params.in_size_i, params.in_size_j,
                         params.out_size_i, params.out_size_j)
    cpu_ms = (time_ns() - cpu_start) ÷ 1_000_000
    println("host execution time: $cpu_ms ms")

    d_in = CuArray(input)
    d_out = CuArray{XYZ}(undef, params.out_size_i * params.out_size_j)
    threads = params.work_group_size
    blocks = cld(params.out_size_i, threads)

    CUDA.synchronize()
    kernel_start = time_ns()
    @cuda threads=threads blocks=blocks bezier_gpu_kernel(
        d_in, d_out, Int32(params.in_size_i), Int32(params.in_size_j),
        Int32(params.out_size_i), Int32(params.out_size_j))
    CUDA.synchronize()
    kernel_ms = (time_ns() - kernel_start) ÷ 1_000_000
    println("kernel execution time: $kernel_ms ms")

    gpu_out = Array(d_out)
    status = compare_output(gpu_out, cpu_out)
    println(status == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL")
    return status
end

exit(main(ARGS))

    status = compare_output(gpu_out, cpu_out)
    println(status == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL")

using CUDA
using Printf

function bilateral_filter_kernel!(input, output, w::Int32, h::Int32,
                                  a_square::Float32, variance_I::Float32,
                                  variance_spatial::Float32, radius::Int32)
    idx0 = (blockIdx().x - Int32(1)) * blockDim().x + threadIdx().x - Int32(1)
    idy0 = (blockIdx().y - Int32(1)) * blockDim().y + threadIdx().y - Int32(1)
    if idx0 >= w || idy0 >= h
        return
    end

    id = idy0 * w + idx0
    center = input[id + Int32(1)]
    res = Float32(0)
    normalization = Float32(0)

    oi = -radius
    while oi <= radius
        oj = -radius
        while oj <= radius
            idk = idx0 + oi
            idl = idy0 + oj
            if idk < 0
                idk = -idk
            end
            if idl < 0
                idl = -idl
            end
            if idk > w - Int32(1)
                idk = w - Int32(1) - oi
            end
            if idl > h - Int32(1)
                idl = h - Int32(1) - oj
            end

            id_w = idl * w + idk
            I_w = input[id_w + Int32(1)]
            range = -((center - I_w) * (center - I_w)) / (Float32(2) * variance_I)
            spatial = -(Float32((idk - idx0) * (idk - idx0) + (idl - idy0) * (idl - idy0))) /
                      (Float32(2) * variance_spatial)
            weight = a_square * exp(spatial + range)
            normalization += weight
            res += I_w * weight
            oj += Int32(1)
        end
        oi += Int32(1)
    end
    output[id + Int32(1)] = res / normalization
    return
end

function reference!(input, output, w::Int, h::Int, a_square::Float32,
                    variance_I::Float32, variance_spatial::Float32, radius::Int)
    for idx0 in 0:w-1, idy0 in 0:h-1
        id = idy0 * w + idx0 + 1
        center = input[id]
        res = Float32(0)
        normalization = Float32(0)
        for oi in -radius:radius, oj in -radius:radius
            idk = idx0 + oi
            idl = idy0 + oj
            if idk < 0
                idk = -idk
            end
            if idl < 0
                idl = -idl
            end
            if idk > w - 1
                idk = w - 1 - oi
            end
            if idl > h - 1
                idl = h - 1 - oj
            end
            id_w = idl * w + idk + 1
            I_w = input[id_w]
            range = -((center - I_w) * (center - I_w)) / (Float32(2) * variance_I)
            spatial = -(Float32((idk - idx0)^2 + (idl - idy0)^2)) / (Float32(2) * variance_spatial)
            weight = a_square * exp(spatial + range)
            normalization += weight
            res += I_w * weight
        end
        output[id] = res / normalization
    end
    return output
end

function c_rand_mod(n::Int)
    return Int(ccall(:rand, Cint, ())) % n
end

function run_radius!(d_src, d_dst, h_src, h_dst, r_dst, w::Int, h::Int,
                     a_square::Float32, variance_I::Float32,

    threads = (16, 16)
    blocks = (cld(w, 16), cld(h, 16))

using CUDA,Printf
const BM_W=112;const BM_H=40;const BM_G=768;const BM_R=10
bmread(name,::Type{T})where T=collect(reinterpret(T,read(joinpath(@__DIR__,name))))
function bm_study(factory)
 input=bmread("study_input_u8.bin",UInt8);window=bmread("study_window_f32.bin",Float32)
 specs=((:img,UInt8,4480),(:win,Float32,64),(:stacks,UInt16,11520),(:counts,UInt32,768),(:weights,Float32,768),(:group,Float32,786432),(:num,Float32,4480),(:den,Float32,4480),(:out,UInt8,4480))
 bufs=Dict();views=Dict();sentinels=Dict()
 for (name,T,n) in specs
  sentinel=T===UInt8 ? T(165) : T===UInt16 ? T(23063) : T===UInt32 ? T(1234567) : T(1515.25)
  b=CUDA.fill(sentinel,n+32);bufs[name]=b;views[name]=view(b,17:n+16);sentinels[name]=sentinel
 end
 a=(; (name=>views[name] for (name,_,_) in  specs)...);copyto!(a.img,input);copyto!(a.win,window);launch=factory(a)
 function reset!()
  fill!(a.stacks,UInt16(0));fill!(a.counts,UInt32(0));fill!(a.weights,0f0);fill!(a.group,0f0);fill!(a.out,UInt8(0))
 end
 function run!()
  fill!(a.num,0f0);fill!(a.den,0f0);launch()
 end
 reset!();run!();CUDA.device_synchronize(blocking=true)
 es=bmread("oracle_stacks_u16.bin",UInt16);ec=bmread("oracle_counts_u32.bin",UInt32);enz=bmread("oracle_nonzero_u32.bin",UInt32);ep=bmread("oracle_post_f32.bin",Float32);en=bmread("oracle_num_f32.bin",Float32);ed=bmread("oracle_den_f32.bin",Float32);eo=bmread("oracle_output_u8.bin",UInt8);allok=true
 for trial in 1:5
  reset!();CUDA.device_synchronize(blocking=true);start=time_ns();for _ in 1:10;run!();end;CUDA.device_synchronize(blocking=true);seconds=(time_ns()-start)*1e-9/10
  h=(; (name=>Array(views[name]) for (name,_,_) in  specs)...);ok=h.img==input&&h.win==window&&h.stacks==es&&h.counts==ec;ma=0.;mr=0.;scaled=0.
  for (got,expected) in  ((h.group,ep),(h.num,en),(h.den,ed))
   errors=abs.(Float64.(got).-Float64.(expected));ma=max(ma,maximum(errors));mr=max(mr,maximum(errors./max.(abs.(Float64.(expected)),1.)));scaled=max(scaled,maximum(errors./(0.003 .+ 0.0003 .*abs.(Float64.(expected)))));ok&=all(isfinite,got)&&all(errors.<=0.003 .+ 0.0003 .*abs.(Float64.(expected)))
  end
  nz=Int.(round.(ifelse.(h.weights.>0,1f0./h.weights,0f0)));nze=count(nz.!=Int.(enz));ok&=nze==0;ie=maximum(abs.(Int.(h.out).-Int.(eo)));ok&=ie<=1&&all(h.den.>0)
  art=vcat(Float32.(h.img),h.win,Float32[112,40,64,12,19,8,16,3,625,2.7,2500,10],Float32.(h.stacks),Float32.(h.counts),h.weights,h.group,h.num,h.den,Float32.(h.out))
  for(name,_,n) in  specs
   raw=Array(bufs[name]);for j in 1:16;push!(art,Float32(raw[j]),Float32(raw[n+16+j]));ok&=raw[j]==sentinels[name]&&raw[n+16+j]==sentinels[name];end

  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1;nonzero=0;threshold=2.7f0*sqrt(Float32(n*625));v=MVector{16,Float32}(ntuple(_->0f0,Val(16)))
  for l in 0:63
   for z in 1:n;v[z]=@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+(z-1)*64+l+1];end
   step=1
   while step<n
    for j in 1:2*step:n,k in 0:step-1;a=v[j+k];b=v[j+k+step];v[j+k]=a+b;v[j+k+step]=a-b;end

@inline function match_lane!(g,img,stacks,counts)
 gx=(g-1)%64;gy=(g-1)÷64;px=gx*3;py=gy*3
 if 105<=px<107;px=104;end
 if 33<=py<35;py=32;end
 if px<105&&py<33
  best=MVector{15,UInt32}(ntuple(_->typemax(UInt32),Val(15)));found=0;base=(gx÷32)*96
  for dy in max(-19,-py):min(19,32-py),dx in max(-19,-base):min(19,104-px)
   if !(dx==0&&dy==0)
    diff=UInt32(0)
    for y in 0:7,x in 0:7
     a=Int32(@inbounds img[px+x+(py+y)*112+1]);b=Int32(@inbounds img[px+dx+x+(py+dy+y)*112+1]);d=a-b;diff+=UInt32(d*d)
    end
    if diff<UInt32(160000)
     key=((diff>>2)<<16)|(UInt32(dy&255)<<8)|UInt32(dx&255)
     if key<best[15]
      j=15
      while j>1&&key<best[j-1];best[j]=best[j-1];j-=1;end
      best[j]=key
     end
     found=min(found+1,15)
    end
   end
  end
  for z in 1:found;@inbounds stacks[(g-1)*15+z]=UInt16(best[z]&UInt32(65535));end
  depth=1;while depth*2<=found+1;depth*=2;end
  @inbounds counts[g]=UInt32(depth-1)
 end
 nothing
end

@inline function hard_lane!(g,group,counts,weights)

  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1;nonzero=0;threshold=2.7f0*sqrt(Float32(n*625));v=MVector{16,Float32}(ntuple(_->0f0,Val(16)))
  for l in 0:63

@inline function match_lane!(g,img,stacks,counts)
 gx=(g-1)%64;gy=(g-1)÷64;px=gx*3;py=gy*3
 if 105<=px<107;px=104;end
 if 33<=py<35;py=32;end
 if px<105&&py<33
  best=MVector{15,UInt32}(ntuple(_->typemax(UInt32),Val(15)));found=0;base=(gx÷32)*96
  for dy in max(-19,-py):min(19,32-py),dx in max(-19,-base):min(19,104-px)
   if !(dx==0&&dy==0)
    diff=UInt32(0)
    for y in 0:7,x in 0:7
     a=Int32(@inbounds img[px+x+(py+y)*112+1]);b=Int32(@inbounds img[px+dx+x+(py+dy+y)*112+1]);d=a-b;diff+=UInt32(d*d)
    end
    if diff<UInt32(160000)
     key=((diff>>2)<<16)|(UInt32(dy&255)<<8)|UInt32(dx&255)
     if key<best[15]
      j=15
      while j>1&&key<best[j-1];best[j]=best[j-1];j-=1;end
      best[j]=key
     end
     found=min(found+1,15)
    end
   end
  end
  for z in 1:found;@inbounds stacks[(g-1)*15+z]=UInt16(best[z]&UInt32(65535));end
  depth=1;while depth*2<=found+1;depth*=2;end
  @inbounds counts[g]=UInt32(depth-1)
 end
 nothing
end

  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1;nonzero=0;threshold=2.7f0*sqrt(Float32(n*625));v=MVector{16,Float32}(ntuple(_->0f0,Val(16)))

@inline function match_lane!(g,img,stacks,counts)
 gx=(g-1)%64;gy=(g-1)÷64;px=gx*3;py=gy*3
 if 105<=px<107;px=104;end
 if 33<=py<35;py=32;end
 if px<105&&py<33
  best=MVector{15,UInt32}(ntuple(_->typemax(UInt32),Val(15)));found=0;base=(gx÷32)*96
  for dy in max(-19,-py):min(19,32-py),dx in max(-19,-base):min(19,104-px)
   if !(dx==0&&dy==0)
    diff=UInt32(0)
    for y in 0:7,x in 0:7
     a=Int32(@inbounds img[px+x+(py+y)*112+1]);b=Int32(@inbounds img[px+dx+x+(py+dy+y)*112+1]);d=a-b;diff+=UInt32(d*d)
    end
    if diff<UInt32(160000)
     key=((diff>>2)<<16)|(UInt32(dy&255)<<8)|UInt32(dx&255)
     if key<best[15]
      j=15
      while j>1&&key<best[j-1];best[j]=best[j-1];j-=1;end
      best[j]=key
     end
     found=min(found+1,15)
    end
   end
  end
  for z in 1:found;@inbounds stacks[(g-1)*15+z]=UInt16(best[z]&UInt32(65535));end
  depth=1;while depth*2<=found+1;depth*=2;end
  @inbounds counts[g]=UInt32(depth-1)
 end
 nothing
end
@inline function origin(g)

 if 105<=x<107;x=104;end

end
@inline function offset(stacks,g,z)

 v=@inbounds stacks[(g-1)*15+z];x=Int(v&UInt16(255));y=Int(v>>8);(x>=128 ? x-256 : x,y>=128 ? y-256 : y)
end
@inline function gather_lane!(t,img,stacks,counts,group)
 g=(t-1)÷64+1;l=(t-1)%64;x=l%8;y=l÷8;px,py=origin(g)

  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1

@inline function hard_lane!(g,group,counts,weights)
 px,py=origin(g)
 if px<105&&py<33
  n=Int(@inbounds counts[g])+1;nonzero=0;threshold=2.7f0*sqrt(Float32(n*625));v=MVector{16,Float32}(ntuple(_->0f0,Val(16)))
  for l in 0:63
   for z in 1:n;v[z]=@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+(z-1)*64+l+1];end
   step=1
   while step<n
    for j in 1:2*step:n,k in 0:step-1;a=v[j+k];b=v[j+k+step];v[j+k]=a+b;v[j+k+step]=a-b;end
    step*=2
   end
   for z in 1:n

   end
   step=1
   while step<n

    step*=2
   end
   for z in 1:n;@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+(z-1)*64+l+1]=v[z]/Float32(n);end
  end

end

   dx,dy=offset(stacks,g,z);i=px+dx+l%8+(py+dy+l÷8)*112+1;v=@inbounds group[(g-1)*1024+z*64+l+1]

end

module OwnedStudy
using CUDA, Printf
"""Five in-process synchronized host-clock trials, JIT warmed before trial 1.
The same timed launch loop and reset/output boundaries apply to all models.
Full-array CPU checks are outside timing; raw outputs enable dual comparisons.
"""
function run_trials!(launch!, reset!, readback, expected, repeats; atol=0.0, rtol=0.0)
    repeats > 0 || error("positive internal repeat count required")
    reset!(); launch!(); CUDA.synchronize()
    allok = true
    for trial in 1:5
        reset!(); CUDA.synchronize()
        start = time_ns()
        for _ in 1:repeats
            launch!()
        end
        CUDA.synchronize()
        secs = (time_ns()-start)*1e-9/repeats
        got = vec(readback()); ref = vec(expected)
        length(got)==length(ref) || error("output shape mismatch")
        maxabs=0.0; maxrel=0.0; ok=true
        for (x,y) in zip(got,ref)
            a=abs(Float64(x)-Float64(y))
            b=a/max(abs(Float64(y)),atol,1e-300)
            ok &= isfinite(x) && isfinite(y) && a<=atol+rtol*abs(y)
            maxabs=max(maxabs,a); maxrel=max(maxrel,b)
        end
        allok &= ok
        name="output_trial$(trial).bin"
        path=joinpath(get(ENV,"STUDY_OUTPUT_DIR",pwd()),name)
        write(path,got)
        dtype=eltype(got)==Float32 ? "float32" : eltype(got)==Float64 ? "float64" : eltype(got)==Int32 ? "int32" : eltype(got)==Int64 ? "int64" : error("unsupported dtype")
        @printf("STUDY_TRIAL {\"trial\":%d,\"time_seconds\":%.12g,\"correct\":%s,\"checked_values\":%d,\"max_abs_error\":%.12g,\"max_rel_error\":%.12g,\"timing_region\":\"kernel_launch_loop_per_internal_repeat\",\"jit_excluded\":true,\"internal_repeats\":%d,\"output_artifact\":{\"path\":\"%s\",\"dtype\":\"%s\",\"count\":%d,\"byte_order\":\"little\"}}\n",trial,secs,ok ? "true" : "false",length(got),maxabs,maxrel,repeats,path,dtype,length(got))
    end
    allok || error("CPU numerical verification failed")
    println("PASS")
end
end
include(joinpath(@__DIR__,"main.jl"))

using CUDA
include(joinpath(@__DIR__,"..","_portable_study","OwnedStudy.jl"))
include(joinpath(@__DIR__,"study_helpers.jl"))
function box_cpu(input,w,h)
    temp=zeros(UInt32,w*h);out=zeros(UInt32,w*h);scale=1f0/21f0
    for y in 0:h-1,x in 0:w-1
        s=(0f0,0f0,0f0,0f0)
        for dx in -10:10
            if 0<=x+dx<w
                s=add4(s,rgba(input[y*w+x+dx+1]))
            end
        end
        temp[y*w+x+1]=pack4(s,scale)
    end
    # Native column kernel never stores row0; preserve that observable reset-zero policy explicitly.
    for x in 0:w-1,y in 1:h-1
        s=(0f0,0f0,0f0,0f0)
        for dy in -10:10
            s=add4(s,rgba(temp[clamp(y+dy,0,h-1)*w+x+1]))
        end
        out[y*w+x+1]=pack4(s,scale)
    end
    out
end
function box_study(factory)
    w=256;h=128;repeats=10
    input=UInt32[UInt32((13*x+7*y)%256)|(UInt32((3*x+11*y)%256)<<8)|(UInt32((17*x+5*y)%256)<<16)|(UInt32((19*x+23*y)%256)<<24) for y in 0:h-1 for x in 0:w-1]
    expected=Int64.(box_cpu(input,w,h));a=CuArray(input);temp=CUDA.zeros(UInt32,w*h);out=CUDA.zeros(UInt32,w*h)
    launch! = factory(a,temp,out,Int32(w),Int32(h),1f0/21f0)
    reset!()=(fill!(temp,UInt32(0));fill!(out,UInt32(0)))
    # Lossless UInt32->Int64 artifact widening outside measured GPU work.
    OwnedStudy.run_trials!(launch!,reset!,()->Int64.(Array(out)),expected,repeats;atol=0.,rtol=0.)
end

using CUDA, Printf
"""Five in-process synchronized host-clock trials, JIT warmed before trial 1.
The same timed launch loop and reset/output boundaries apply to all models.
Full-array CPU checks are outside timing; raw outputs enable dual comparisons.
"""
function run_trials!(launch!, reset!, readback, expected, repeats; atol=0.0, rtol=0.0)
    repeats > 0 || error("positive internal repeat count required")
    reset!(); launch!(); CUDA.synchronize()
    allok = true
    for trial in 1:5
        reset!(); CUDA.synchronize()
        start = time_ns()
        for _ in 1:repeats
            launch!()
        end
        CUDA.synchronize()
        secs = (time_ns()-start)*1e-9/repeats
        got = vec(readback()); ref = vec(expected)
        length(got)==length(ref) || error("output shape mismatch")
        maxabs=0.0; maxrel=0.0; ok=true
        for (x,y) in zip(got,ref)
            a=abs(Float64(x)-Float64(y))
            b=a/max(abs(Float64(y)),atol,1e-300)
            ok &= isfinite(x) && isfinite(y) && a<=atol+rtol*abs(y)
            maxabs=max(maxabs,a); maxrel=max(maxrel,b)
        end
        allok &= ok
        name="output_trial$(trial).bin"
        path=joinpath(get(ENV,"STUDY_OUTPUT_DIR",pwd()),name)
        write(path,got)
        dtype=eltype(got)==Float32 ? "float32" : eltype(got)==Float64 ? "float64" : eltype(got)==Int32 ? "int32" : eltype(got)==Int64 ? "int64" : error("unsupported dtype")
        @printf("STUDY_TRIAL {\"trial\":%d,\"time_seconds\":%.12g,\"correct\":%s,\"checked_values\":%d,\"max_abs_error\":%.12g,\"max_rel_error\":%.12g,\"timing_region\":\"kernel_launch_loop_per_internal_repeat\",\"jit_excluded\":true,\"internal_repeats\":%d,\"output_artifact\":{\"path\":\"%s\",\"dtype\":\"%s\",\"count\":%d,\"byte_order\":\"little\"}}\n",trial,secs,ok ? "true" : "false",length(got),maxabs,maxrel,repeats,path,dtype,length(got))
    end
    allok || error("CPU numerical verification failed")
    println("PASS")
end
end

using CUDA
using Printf

const REPEAT = 1000
const N = 370
const LDAT = N
const INCX = 1
const INCY = 1
const AT_SIZE = N * LDAT
const X_SIZE = N * INCX
const Y_SIZE = N * INCY

struct ComplexFloat
    Re::Float32
    Im::Float32
end

function chemv_cpu!(alpha_re::Float32, alpha_im::Float32, beta_re::Float32, beta_im::Float32,
                    at::Vector{ComplexFloat}, x::Vector{ComplexFloat}, y::Vector{ComplexFloat})
    @inbounds for i0 in 0:N-1
        yi = y[i0 * INCY + 1]
        y[i0 * INCY + 1] = ComplexFloat(yi.Re * beta_re - yi.Im * beta_im,
                                        yi.Im * beta_re + yi.Re * beta_im)
    end

    @inbounds for i1 in 0:N-1
        a = at[i1 * LDAT + i1 + 1]
        xi = x[i1 * INCX + 1]
        yi = y[i1 * INCY + 1]
        var2_re = alpha_re * a.Re
        var2_im = alpha_im * a.Re
        var3_re = var2_re * xi.Re - var2_im * xi.Im
        var3_im = var2_im * xi.Re + var2_re * xi.Im
        y[i1 * INCY + 1] = ComplexFloat(yi.Re + var3_re, yi.Im + var3_im)
    end

    @inbounds for i2 in 0:N-2
        for i3 in 0:N-2-i2
            a = at[i2 * LDAT + (1 + i2) + i3 + 1]
            xhi = x[(i3 + i2 + 1) * INCX + 1]
            yi = y[i2 * INCY + 1]
            var94_re = alpha_re * a.Re - alpha_im * (-a.Im)
            var94_im = alpha_im * a.Re + alpha_re * (-a.Im)
            var95_re = var94_re * xhi.Re - var94_im * xhi.Im
            var95_im = var94_im * xhi.Re + var94_re * xhi.Im
            y[i2 * INCY + 1] = ComplexFloat(yi.Re + var95_re, yi.Im + var95_im)

            xlo = x[i2 * INCX + 1]
            yj = y[(i3 + i2 + 1) * INCY + 1]
            var97_re = alpha_re * a.Re - alpha_im * a.Im
            var97_im = alpha_im * a.Re + alpha_re * a.Im
            var98_re = var97_re * xlo.Re - var97_im * xlo.Im
            var98_im = var97_im * xlo.Re + var97_re * xlo.Im
            y[(i3 + i2 + 1) * INCY + 1] = ComplexFloat(yj.Re + var98_re, yj.Im + var98_im)
        end
    end
    return
end

function chemv_kernel0!(at, x, y, alpha_im::Float32, alpha_re::Float32, beta_im::Float32, beta_re::Float32)
    b0 = blockIdx().x - Int32(1)
    t0 = threadIdx().x - Int32(1)
    row = Int32(32) * b0 + t0

    for c1 in Int32(0):Int32(32):min(Int32(368), Int32(32) * b0 + Int32(30))
        if row <= Int32(369) && c1 == Int32(0)
            yi = @inbounds y[row + Int32(1)]
            yscaled = ComplexFloat(yi.Re * beta_re - yi.Im * beta_im,
                                   yi.Im * beta_re + yi.Re * beta_im)
            @inbounds y[row + Int32(1)] = yscaled
            a = @inbounds at[Int32(11872) * b0 + Int32(371) * t0 + Int32(1)]
            xi = @inbounds x[row + Int32(1)]
            var2_re = alpha_re * a.Re
            var2_im = alpha_im * a.Re
            var3_re = var2_re * xi.Re - var2_im * xi.Im
            var3_im = var2_im * xi.Re + var2_re * xi.Im
            @inbounds y[row + Int32(1)] = ComplexFloat(yscaled.Re + var3_re, yscaled.Im + var3_im)
        end
        if row <= Int32(369)
            for c3 in Int32(0):min(Int32(31), row - c1 - Int32(1))
                a = @inbounds at[row + Int32(370) * c1 + Int32(370) * c3 + Int32(1)]
                xc = @inbounds x[c1 + c3 + Int32(1)]
                yi = @inbounds y[row + Int32(1)]
                var97_re = alpha_re * a.Re - alpha_im * a.Im
                var97_im = alpha_im * a.Re + alpha_re * a.Im
                var98_re = var97_re * xc.Re - var97_im * xc.Im
                var98_im = var97_im * xc.Re + var97_re * xc.Im
                @inbounds y[row + Int32(1)] = ComplexFloat(yi.Re + var98_re, yi.Im + var98_im)
            end
        end
        sync_threads()
    end
    return
end

function chemv_kernel1!(at, x, y, alpha_im::Float32, alpha_re::Float32)
    b0 = blockIdx().x - Int32(1)
    t0 = threadIdx().x - Int32(1)
    row = Int32(32) * b0 + t0

    for c1 in Int32(5888) * b0:Int32(32):min(Int32(67712), Int32(5856) * b0 + Int32(6016))
        lo = max(Int32(0), Int32(5888) * b0 + Int32(184) * t0 - c1)
        hi = min(Int32(31), Int32(5856) * b0 + Int32(183) * t0 - c1 + Int32(368))
        for c3 in lo:hi
            idx = Int32(5984) * b0 + Int32(187) * t0 + c1 + c3 + Int32(2)
            a = @inbounds at[idx]
            xidx = -Int32(5856) * b0 - Int32(183) * t0 + c1 + c3 + Int32(2)
            xv = @inbounds x[xidx]
            yi = @inbounds y[row + Int32(1)]
            var94_re = alpha_re * a.Re - alpha_im * (-a.Im)
            var94_im = alpha_im * a.Re + alpha_re * (-a.Im)
            var95_re = var94_re * xv.Re - var94_im * xv.Im
            var95_im = var94_im * xv.Re + var94_re * xv.Im
            @inbounds y[row + Int32(1)] = ComplexFloat(yi.Re + var95_re, yi.Im + var95_im)
        end
        sync_threads()
    end
    return
end

function chemv_gpu!(alpha_re::Float32, alpha_im::Float32, beta_re::Float32, beta_im::Float32,
                    at::Vector{ComplexFloat}, x::Vector{ComplexFloat}, y::Vector{ComplexFloat})
    d_at = CuArray(at)
    d_x = CuArray(x)
    d_y = CuArray(y)

    CUDA.synchronize()
    start = time_ns()
    for _ in 1:REPEAT
        @cuda threads=32 blocks=12 chemv_kernel0!(d_at, d_x, d_y, alpha_im, alpha_re, beta_im, beta_re)
        @cuda threads=32 blocks=12 chemv_kernel1!(d_at, d_x, d_y, alpha_im, alpha_re)
    end
    CUDA.synchronize()
    elapsed = time_ns() - start
    @printf("Average execution time of chemv kernels: %f (us)\n", elapsed * 1.0e-3 / REPEAT)

    y .= Array(d_y)
    return
end

function main()
    at = Vector{ComplexFloat}(undef, AT_SIZE)
    x = Vector{ComplexFloat}(undef, X_SIZE)
    y_cpu = Vector{ComplexFloat}(undef, Y_SIZE)
    y_gpu = Vector{ComplexFloat}(undef, Y_SIZE)

    @inbounds for i in 0:N-1
        x[i * INCX + 1] = ComplexFloat(Float32(i + 5), Float32(i * 2))
        y_cpu[i * INCY + 1] = ComplexFloat(Float32(i * 3), Float32(i + 7))
        y_gpu[i * INCY + 1] = ComplexFloat(Float32(i * 3), Float32(i + 7))
        for j in 0:LDAT-1
            at[i * LDAT + j + 1] = ComplexFloat(Float32(i + j), Float32(i + 3))
        end
    end

    alpha_re = Float32(3.14)
    alpha_im = Float32(1.59)
    beta_re = Float32(2.71)
    beta_im = Float32(8.28)

    chemv_cpu!(alpha_re, alpha_im, beta_re, beta_im, at, x, y_cpu)
    chemv_gpu!(alpha_re, alpha_im, beta_re, beta_im, at, x, y_gpu)

    @inbounds for i in 0:N-1
        yc = y_cpu[i * INCY + 1]
        yg = y_gpu[i * INCY + 1]
        if abs(yc.Re - yg.Re) > 1.0f-3 || abs(yc.Im - yg.Im) > 1.0f-3
            @printf("%d %f %f\n", i, yc.Re, yg.Re)
            println("FAIL")
            return 1
        end
    end
    println("PASS")
    return 0
end

exit(main())

        got = vec(readback()); ref = vec(expected)
        length(got)==length(ref) || error("output shape mismatch")
        maxabs=0.0; maxrel=0.0; ok=true
        for (x,y) in zip(got,ref)
            a=abs(Float64(x)-Float64(y))
            b=a/max(abs(Float64(y)),atol,1e-300)
            ok &= isfinite(x) && isfinite(y) && a<=atol+rtol*abs(y)
            maxabs=max(maxabs,a); maxrel=max(maxrel,b)

        allok &= ok
        name="output_trial$(trial).bin"
        path=joinpath(get(ENV,"STUDY_OUTPUT_DIR",pwd()),name)
        write(path,got)
        dtype=eltype(got)==Float32 ? "float32" : eltype(got)==Float64 ? "float64" : eltype(got)==Int32 ? "int32" : eltype(got)==Int64 ? "int64" : error("unsupported dtype")

    end
    allok || error("CPU numerical verification failed")
    println("PASS")
end
end
